# romp

> romp is an open-source Go CLI that watches a GitHub repository for labelled issues, runs a local coding agent in an isolated git worktree, independently reruns the repository's verification command, and opens a pull request.

## Product summary

- Runs Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode locally through the user's existing login.
- Uses GitHub and the authenticated `gh` CLI as the source of truth.
- Gives every job a goal contract: GATE, DONE, PROVE IT, and CONSTRAINTS.
- Bundles the `rompify` skill for compiling short requests and GitHub issues into execution contracts.
- Never merges pull requests or deploys production.
- Blocks under-specified issues before code changes and reports the missing detail.

## Key documentation

- [Getting started](https://romp.sidv.dev/docs/getting-started/): requirements, installation, and first run
- [Commands](https://romp.sidv.dev/docs/commands/): command and flag reference
- [Configuration](https://romp.sidv.dev/docs/configuration/): `romp.toml` and configuration layering
- [Goal contract](https://romp.sidv.dev/docs/goal-contract/): the agent's finish line
- [Architecture](https://romp.sidv.dev/docs/architecture/): job lifecycle and system design
- [Safety](https://romp.sidv.dev/docs/safety/): permissions, secrets, and operational boundaries
